name: JHM Consolidation Berhad
overview: 2026年，JHM Consolidation Berhad 未在公告中披露具体业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及关联交易授权等常规事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比上升57.5%至117,525,000令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, JHM Consolidation Berhad did not disclose any specific segment expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment in its announcements; the announcements were mainly routine matters such as quarterly results, general meetings, and renewal of related party transaction mandate. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 57.5% year-on-year to MYR 117,525,000.
